trails.title: Wine Brewing Season
trails.description: A verse from an unknown source, recorded on a scroll.

content.text:
—Bang!
In the distance, something falls.
The cup drains the wine,
Tired eyes dry out the sun.
Everyone clings to the remaining days,
The body speaks to its guest.

Who builds, also uses the same hand
To destroy, to peel open the rock walls,
The scar is a perfect circle.
A death tied with a knot, thus
—The end.

Only it remains:
The wilderness.
Everything extraneous, swarming in,
Just like that, they talk about a bottomed sky.

items.text: The Party of Beans

One, abstain from beans.
Two, do not pick up what has fallen. 
Three, touch not a white rooster.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Hmm.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Where am I?
After a long period of darkness, clarity begins to dawn.
Ahead lies a completely unfamiliar scene.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Did the earthquake do this?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I was in the cave with 37.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Is the timer broken?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Hey, Vertin! Here you are!
A familiar shout is heard in the distance.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Yeah. Come! People are waiting. The feast is going to start!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Feast?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Yes. Today's the big day!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: We're celebrating because we kicked Manus Vindictae off the island, found the key to "Storm" immunity, and saved the "numbers people" from great disaster!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What?
But Regulus has already taken off.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Come on, Vertin! You'll miss out on the delicious honey-roasted rabbit!
She jumps forward excitedly, but something cracks loudly when she lands.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Wait, Regulus! You just kicked over something.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: What? What is it? Something for the cattle? Whoever left this here nearly tripped this great captain!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Forget it. Come, Vertin! What are you still doing there!

Four, do not poke the fire with swords. 
Five, do not jump over a crossbar. 
Six, do not cut wood on a main road.
The square is alive with joy and activity. The usual silence and seriousness have been replaced by a symphony of giggles and cheers.
The aroma of roast rabbit is thick in the air. Barrels of wine are being rolled around, and people are gathered, drinking and chatting merrily.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Ah! Nice wine. Did you make it yourself?
Careful, Ms. Lilya. Too much wine can corrupt one's body and will. Besides, you are already halfway through our stock for the year.
Hmm, but this drink you brought is pleasant to the nose. "Coffee," you said? I have heard many things about it.
Oh, oh, bitter.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hah, poor guy! I was expecting more from a man of your size!
She goes to a barrel to fill her cup.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: For god's sake, Regulus! Keep an eye on your first mate here.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Wow. He is so out of it right now.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: *burp*

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: It appears that this APPLe's abstinence from the bottle will have to begin anew.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Vertin! Finally! I was looking for you!
37 waves from a distance, Sophia at her side, arm in arm.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Hello, everyone! We have a big announcement to make.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Sophia's just completed her proof and found her number!
Wings flap from above.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Uhm!

Seven, do not enter the hall in new garments. 
Enter the hall from the right 
and leave from the left.
Eight, do not keep swallows around your house.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Oh, don't worry about the swallows! They're going to fetch 6 for us.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: He's napping in the Hall of Apeiron—an excuse to not join the party.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Not so fast with the announcement, 37! People will find out sooner or later.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Thank you for helping us, Vertin. We wouldn't have made it without you.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: And I look forward to our continued collaboration with the Foundation.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: No. None of this makes any sense.

Nine, do not sleep on a grave. 
Ten, make the bed as soon as you wake up,
leaving no imprint of your body.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Oh. Enough business! People are having a party here!
The pirate comes over with a platter of rabbits, smiling as if England had just won the World Cup.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Well, what do you say to this lovely captain who just picked up some food for you?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Uhm!
They clumsily collide, knocking over the tray in Regulus's hand.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: My apologies, Regulus. I was too focused on linear regression formulas.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ahh, that's alright. Wasn't me getting stuck in the kitchen roasting rabbits all day anyway! Unlimited supply of honeyed rabbits, all day today!
Regulus picks up the dirty clay plate and puts it aside.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I heard Sophia is making her announcement today. I'm curious which number she will be.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Care to wager on that? I'd say she's a multiple of 3!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Mm. Then I'd say she is a multiple of 139.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: I have to admit, she has a good number!

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: A number 100 times better than me, 6, and 210 put together!

items.speaker: Ms. Radio
items.text: Calculating ... (37+6+210)*100 equals to ...
Oh no. She is not 25300. I doubt anyone could live with themselves with a number that long.
*rooster crow*
A rooster crows loudly in the festive atmosphere.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: You haven't met before. This is Amu, my white rooster.
She kneels down and gently strokes its feathers.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Amu, this is Vertin.

Three, touch not 
a white rooster.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: A white rooster?
Cheers and shouts fill the air as people revel in jubilant euphoria.
A Foundation employee picks up an ID from the ground.

Two, do not pick up 
what has fallen.
An Apeiron believer splits a log in half on the road, earning enthusiastic applause from the crowd.

Six, do not cut wood 
on a main road.
The tables are filled with chickpea salad and neatly sliced bread, while people use their swords to poke fires and keep them burning.

One, abstain from beans.
Four, do not poke the fire 
with swords.
The flames burn fiercely, casting no shadows on the ground.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Something's not right. None of this is right!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Something's happened on the island. I must still be in the cave!
A churning anxiety fills the chest. The once-joyful scene now takes on a surreal quality.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I have to get out of here!

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: First is the circle, second is the square.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: 37? Is that you?
The little girl does not seem to be listening; she's completely absorbed in building her castle.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Put the triangle on the triangle, and the rectangle on the rectangle.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Perfect! As things should be!
The "Emanation" ... Disorder and chaos ...
This can't be. This isn't right!
How ugly, how inelegant! How could this be the revelation from the patterns of the transcendental Law above? How could such a terrible answer fall on my ears?!
I can't tell the others about this. There must be a mistake! I need proof. I have to go out there.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Uhm!

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Vertin. My child.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Are you here to partake in sand play, as well? No matter how oft we rearrange them, the sight of them never grows stale.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Alas.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: I shall destroy it.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Vertin? Are you awake?
Consciousness is snapped back to reality.
The surroundings have reverted to the rocky walls, still enclosed within the cave.
37 stands with her head tilted, looking curious.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: I, I think I had a terrible dream.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What did you dream?

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Regulus claimed 6's throne and declared this the rock 'n' roll empire of irrational numbers. She took out a jar of coffee beans and stuffed one into my mouth.
37 shakes her head hard, as if trying to rid her mind of the horrific scene.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: I'm relieved that I woke up in time. And you as well!

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Let's go, Vertin! We need to tell everyone the numbers.
She chirps, her face lighting up with delight, finally free from the long nightmare.
A beam of daylight appears before them.
The lengthy trial has finally come to an end.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Do you hear that? So many people out there!

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Must be Sophia here to pick me up! I told her she can wait for me outside.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Sophia!
The girl runs happily towards the light.
Like a young swallow swooping out of sight.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Wait, 37!
Got to catch up.
Got to leave this place at once.
Must share the findings here with the others.
Finally, the light of day comes into view.
A gust of wind suddenly rushes by, sending pebbles scattering across the ground.
The all too familiar stench of sulfur fills the air.
It is unmistakably the smoke of war.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What?
TO BE CONTINUED…
